core_claim.P: An operator sets minLimitOrderAmountInBase larger than lotSizeInBase (e.g., min=100, lot=50), and a large order is partially filled leaving a remainder that meets the minimum size but is not aligned to lot size boundaries
core_claim.I: Order lifecycle guarantee that orders can be amended after partial fills, requiring that minLimitOrderAmountInBase does not exceed lotSizeInBase so amendments pass both minimum size and lot size validation
core_claim.V: Order amendment reverts because the remainder passes the minimum size check but fails lot size validation, leaving the order in an unusable state

direct_impacts.description: Order amendment operation reverts, leaving the order in an unusable state
